title: Linear factorization of a separable monic polynomial over a separably closed field
statement: Let $K$ be a separably closed field [def-kun-separably-closed, def-pc-separably-closed, def-weil-field]. Let $h\in K[T]$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring] be monic (its leading coefficient is $1$) and separable [def-pc-separable-polynomial]. Then there is a finite list $a_1,\ldots,a_n\in K$, possibly empty, such that $h(T)=\prod_{i=1}^n(T-a_i)$ in $K[T]$. The empty product is $1$.
